parameters.description: What the agent should do, in plain English. Be specific about where to go and what to bring back, for example: 'Go to news.ycombinator.com and return the titles and links of the top 5 stories.'

examples.label: Research
examples.value: Find the top 3 trending repositories on GitHub today and summarize what each one does.

examples.label: Price check
examples.value: Check the current price of the base 14-inch MacBook Pro on apple.com and report it.

examples.label: Save a file
examples.value: Collect the name, price and rating of the first 10 results for 'standing desk' on amazon.com and save them as desks.csv in the workspace.

parameters.name: task

parameters.description: Which model drives the agent. Defaults to GPT-6 Luna, Browser Use's recommended model.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: How hard the model thinks before each step: more is slower and costs more, less is faster. Leave blank for the model's own default (High for GPT-6 Luna). Only OpenAI, Claude and Gemini models have this setting.
parameters.name: reasoning_effort

parameters.description: Continue an existing session so the agent keeps the earlier conversation and browser state. Leave blank to start a fresh session.
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.description: A workspace from 'Create workspace' (or an earlier run's 'workspace_id'). The agent gets the files uploaded to it, and whatever it saves stays there for 'Download workspace file'. Leave blank for a new, empty workspace.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: Stop the run once it has cost this much, in US dollars. Leave blank for no limit.
parameters.name: max_cost_usd

parameters.description: ID of a Browser Use browser profile to load, so the agent reuses saved cookies and logins. Leave blank for a clean browser.
parameters.name: profile_id

parameters.description: Two-letter ISO country code to route the browser through, such as 'us', 'de', or 'jp'. Defaults to the United States. Enter 'none' to run without a proxy.
parameters.name: proxy_country_code

parameters.description: Browser window width in pixels (320-6144). Leave blank for the default.
parameters.name: screen_width

parameters.description: Browser window height in pixels (320-3456). Leave blank for the default.
parameters.name: screen_height

parameters.description: Record the browser session to a video. It is ready once the browser stops: stop it with 'Stop browser', then 'Get browser' returns the recording link.
parameters.name: record

parameters.description: Give the agent its own temporary email address it can send, receive and read mail with, such as to sign up for a site or receive a verification code.
parameters.display_name: Give the agent an email inbox
parameters.name: agentmail

parameters.description: Credentials the agent can have typed into a field without ever seeing them. Give each an alias, refer to the alias in the task (for example 'sign in with acme_password'), and list the sites it may be typed into. They apply to this run only; a follow-up run that needs them must be given them again.
parameters.name: secret_bindings

alias.description: Name the task uses for it, e.g. 'acme_password' (lowercase letters, digits, - and _).

allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated sites it may be typed into, e.g. 'acme.com' (covers its subdomains).

value.description: The secret itself. Save it under Secrets and Values and use it here as @secrets.YOUR_NAME rather than pasting it.

parameters.description: Have Browser Use grade the finished run with an LLM judge. The verdict shows up in the run's 'judgement' field a little after the run ends, and its cost is billed to the run.
parameters.name: judge

parameters.description: Extra context for the judge, such as what a successful outcome looks like. Filling this in turns grading on.
parameters.name: judge_context

returns.description: The run that was just started. It has no result yet; poll 'Get run status' with the returned ID, then 'Get run'.

events_url.description: URL of the run's live event stream.

id.description: The new run's ID. Pass it to 'Get run status' and 'Get run'.

is_terminal.description: False for a run that has just started; poll 'Get run status' until it turns true.

missing_file_ids.description: Any attached file IDs Browser Use could not find.

session_id.description: ID of the session (conversation) the run belongs to. Pass it to 'Send follow-up message' or to a later run to continue.

status.description: Where the run starts out: queued, dispatching, or running. The agent has not finished yet.

task.description: The instruction the agent was given.

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace the run's files live in. Pass it to 'List workspace files' to see what the agent saved.

stop_browser.description: Stop a cloud browser and get its unused time refunded. Use it once a run's browser is no longer needed for follow-ups, so it stops billing and frees a concurrency slot. It cannot be restarted.
stop_browser.name: stop_browser

parameters.description: The cloud browser's ID, from 'List browsers' (filter it by a run's session to find the browser that run used) or 'Start a browser'.
parameters.name: browser_id

agent_session_id.description: The agent session that started the browser, or null for one started with 'Start a browser'.

browser_cost_usd.description: What the browser's running time cost, in US dollars.

cdp_url.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol URL, for automation tools.

finished_at.description: When the browser stopped (ISO 8601), or null.

is_active.description: True while the browser is running (and billing).

live_url.description: Link to watch and control the browser live. Treat it like a password: anyone with it can use the browser.

proxy_cost_usd.description: What its proxy traffic cost, in US dollars.

recording_available.description: False when no recording will ever appear (recording was off). Null in lists.

recording_url.description: Download link for the recording, once a recorded browser has stopped and the video is processed. Only 'Get browser' fills it in.

timeout_at.description: When the browser stops on its own (ISO 8601).

unshare_session.description: Turn a session's public link off. Sharing the session again brings the same link back.
unshare_session.name: unshare_session

parameters.description: The session (conversation) to use: the 'session_id' returned by 'Start a browser task', 'Get run' or 'List sessions'.
parameters.name: session_id

created_at.description: When the session was first shared (ISO 8601).

share_token.description: The token at the end of the link.

share_url.description: Public link anyone can open to view the session.

view_count.description: How many times the link has been opened.

update_profile.description: Rename a browser profile or change the user ID it is filed under.
update_profile.name: update_profile

parameters.description: The browser profile's ID, from 'List profiles' or 'Create profile'.
parameters.name: profile_id

parameters.description: The profile's new name. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The profile's new user identifier. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: external_user_id

cookie_domains.description: Sites the profile holds cookies (logins) for.

external_user_id.description: Your own user identifier for the profile, or null.

id.description: The profile's ID. Pass it as 'Browser profile ID' to start a browser that is already signed in.

last_used_at.description: When a browser last used the profile (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: When the profile was last updated (ISO 8601).

upload_workspace_file.description: Put a file in a workspace, under 'uploads/', for the agent to work with: every run given the workspace gets the file at the start. Up to 50 MB per file.
upload_workspace_file.display_str_template: Upload a file to Browser Use workspace {workspace_id}
upload_workspace_file.name: upload_workspace_file

parameters.description: The workspace holding the files: the 'workspace_id' a run returns, or the 'id' from 'Create workspace'.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: The file to upload: upload one, pick a file from an earlier step, or paste a public https:// link to it.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: The file's name in the workspace, such as 'leads.csv'. Leave blank to keep its own name. Browser Use stores it in lower case, with spaces and symbols as underscores, so use the 'path' this step returns.
parameters.name: filename

parameters.description: Replace a file of the same name already in the workspace. Turn off to fail instead.
parameters.display_name: Replace a file with the same name
parameters.name: overwrite

path.description: Its path in the workspace, e.g. 'uploads/leads.csv'.

replaced.description: Whether it replaced a file of the same name.

stored_name.description: The name it is stored under, made safe.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the file went to.

description: Hand a web task to a Browser Use cloud agent in plain English: it drives a real browser to research, fill in forms, pull data off pages, and report back. Give it files in a workspace and download what it saves, start it signed in with a browser profile, follow up in the same session to keep the browser and context, and read the agent's step-by-step trace when you need to see how it got there.
